reply_body: Sorry about this — the app is closing straight away on your Redmi Note 12 since yesterday's update, so you can't get in at all. Our engineering team will look into crashes on Android 13 for this build and get a fix out. In the meantime, clearing the app cache from Settings > Apps > Dhaba > Storage sometimes gets it opening again, so it's worth a try. If you can tell us whether it crashes on the splash screen or just after, that will help narrow it down.
summary: Paying user reports app crashes immediately on launch after latest update on Android 13 device.
